[EN] That young aman, Dankan, was trapped here when the argons attacked. Praise Kaia, his spirit remains unbroken.

He struggles to complete his hushang—his coming of age ceremony—so that he might join our fight.
[ES] Ese joven aman, Dankan, quedó atrapado aquí cuando los argons atacaron. Alabada sea Kaia, su espíritu sigue inquebrantable.

Lucha por completar su hushang —su ceremonia de madurez— para poder unirse a nuestra pelea.
